description: Calculates South African transfer duty payable to SARS on a property purchase, using the current sliding scale (no duty up to R1,210,000). Notes when VAT applies instead (seller is a VAT vendor).

seller_is_vat_vendor.description: True if the seller is a VAT vendor selling in the course of business (VAT applies instead of transfer duty). Default false

name: transfer_duty
title: Calculate SARS transfer duty
